instruction.text: Sort these sentences into the correct categories.

trainers.hint:
A sentence is in the active voice when the subject is doing the verb.
A sentence is in the passive voice when the verb is being done to the subject.

atoms.b: Ellen wrote her friend a letter.
The chips are fried in the fryer.
